doc: an edited helper gains an axiom: Print Assumptions of its later user must agree with stock
note: The later lemma's term is the helper's name, so replaying it is correct and the fixture's real assertions are the ones that check it: the two compiles print the same Print Assumptions (compare_stdout), which names bad, and write the same .vo. helper itself misses on the key, because its own proof changed. Rocq's constant digest does not hold an opaque constant's proof, so a user that only names it is not disturbed by a change inside it; a user that unfolds a transparent constant reads its body and misses (the const_changed fixture).
